desc: Ideation: formulate answer as 2d plus minimum reduced-cost useful detour when the shortest S-T path is unique.
Implement BFS from S and T and count shortest S-T paths in the distS DAG; if count >= 2, output 2*d.
Reconstruct the unique shortest path P and mark its vertices with indices 0..d.
Implement one multi-source Dijkstra on non-P vertices with weight 1-(distS[v]-distS[u]), sources P except T, initialized from outside neighbors of sources with cost 1-(distS[x]-idx[source]).
Evaluate targets P[1..d-1] and T via outside neighbors to compute min extra; output 2*d+extra or -1.
Verify on samples and edge cases: pure path, internal off-P neighbor, endpoint-only branch, d=1 triangle, multiple shortest paths, outside S-T tunnel.
